ranked.text: Elevated feature-service build latency is the primary upstream bottleneck delaying forecast-pipeline runs.
Feature-service is issuing an abnormally high number of SQL statements per feature build, slowing builds and therefore forecast-pipeline runs.
A recent feature-service rollout or configuration change introduced a regression that slowed feature builds and therefore forecast-pipeline runs.
Database authentication failures in feature-service are causing retries and delaying feature builds, which then delays forecast-pipeline runs.
Forecast-pipeline has its own slow code path or Prefect flow issue, independent of feature-service, causing pipeline p95 duration above 5s.
